settingsPersistence.oldSnapshot: v0.1.0 host read apply-time config only; settings-file edits had no effect until restart and even then were ignored
settingsPersistence.fixedIn: commit 1eee38e (lib/index.js reads scope?.get?.() ?? baseCfg per request)

defectsFixed.title: clean-profile boot failure: undeclared bare import 'schemastery'
defectsFixed.detail: public dsh-sync-manager@0.1.0 declares no runtime dependencies yet lib/index.js imports bare 'schemastery' (line 5). On the daily profile it resolved only via host/other-plugin hoisting; on a clean isolated profile the whole plugin tree failed to load and dsh web aborted (boot 2). Fixed by declaring exact dependency schemastery@3.18.0.

defectsFixed.title: settings-file edits ignored by host (fixed snapshot cfg)
defectsFixed.detail: host gateway read a closure over apply-time config; repoOwner/repoName/branch edits in settings.yaml were persisted but never effective. Fixed to read the live registered settings scope per request.
